passive.name: Fleet of Foot
passive.description: Sivir gains a short burst of Move Speed when she attacks an enemy champion.

spells.name: Boomerang Blade
spells.description: Sivir hurls her crossblade like a boomerang, dealing to all enemies it cuts through. Hitting non-champions reduces the damage to subsequent targets, down to a minimum of %.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation TotalDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Ricochet
spells.description: For the next seconds, Sivir gains % Attack Speed and her auto attacks are empowered to bounce to additional surrounding enemies dealing physical damage each bounce for up to bounces. These bounces critically strike if the attack generating them does.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation BounceDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Spell Shield
spells.description: Sivir creates a magical barrier for seconds that blocks the next incoming enemy Ability. If an ability is blocked, Sivir restores health and triggers Fleet of Foot.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.

spells.name: On The Hunt
spells.description: Sivir rallies her nearby allies, granting them % Move Speed for seconds. Sivir's attacks against champions while On The Hunt reduce the cooldown of her basic abilities by seconds. Takedowns on recently damaged enemies refreshes the duration of the hunt.
spells.coverageNote: No champion damage packet is present for this cast.
